abstract: Abstract It is widely accepted that water markets can support adaptation to climate change. However, quantifying this adaptive capacity is difficult as it requires models that represent both stochastic water supplies and forward-looking behaviour by market participants. We develop a stochastic dynamic model of the Murray-Darling Basin water market in which irrigators form rational expectations over future water prices, and make monthly water use, annual crop planting, and long-run investment decisions. The model is solved using reinforcement learning methods to approximate expectations, combined with mathematical programming to estimate market equilibrium. We validate the model against observed prices and irrigation activity from 2008 to 09 to 2021–22 and apply it to an ensemble of 37 CMIP6 climate projections for the southern Basin. Under drier future climates, water markets support adaptation through increased inter-regional trade flows into the downstream Murray, and larger storage reserves through more conservative crop planting. However, under the driest projections, inter-regional trade constraints bind, price differences widen across zones, and long-run irrigation development contracts by up to 16 per cent. The results highlight both the value and the limits of market-based adaptation, with implications for the design of water market institutions under a non-stationary climate.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Water Markets for Climate Change Adaptation: Trade, Storage, and Investment Under Stochastic Water Supply

abstract: This paper examines how geopolitical risk shapes international trade in low‐carbon technologies (LCTs). Using exporter–product panel data, we find that higher exporter‐level geopolitical risk is associated with lower export values for non‐LCT products, while low‐carbon technology exports respond less negatively and gain export share relative to non‐LCT products. The relative resilience of LCT exports varies across exporter income groups, LCT sectors, and end‐use categories. Two channels appear relevant: LCT resilience is stronger in products with more concentrated global supplier structures and when global energy prices are higher.
abstract_zh: 本文考察地缘政治风险如何塑造低碳技术（LCTs）的国际贸易。基于出口方—产品面板数据，我们发现出口方层面更高的地缘政治风险与非低碳技术产品出口额下降相关，而低碳技术出口的负向反应较小，且相对于非低碳技术产品获得出口份额提升。低碳技术出口的相对韧性因出口方收入组别、低碳技术部门及最终用途类别而异。两条渠道似乎相关：在全球供应商结构更集中的产品中，以及全球能源价格较高时，低碳技术的韧性更强。
china_relevance_reason: 2 位疑似中文姓名作者，且摘要/题名包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: Resilient Trade in Low‐Carbon Technologies Under Geopolitical Risk
title_zh: 地缘政治风险下低碳技术的韧性贸易

abstract: In Surviving Rome, Bowes sounds a clarion call for researchers to focus on the understudied economic lives of the majority 'ninety percent' inhabitants of the early Roman Empire.The dramatis personae of her book are the potters, hustlers, weavers, small holders (emphatically not peasants!),sex workers, children, and drovers.Here, we have the masses, the rustics and urban mob, decried and denigrated by Roman elite writers.It was these masses -the agricultural producers, craftspeople, and purveyor of services -who literally built the Roman Empire and its material world.In many ways, the volume is an antidote to our imaginary Romes and the preconceptions, drawn from textual sources, hazy economic theory, and the odd ethnohistoric analogy, that have sketched their outlines.Sacred cows are slaughtered, and strawmen are burnt along the way.The consumer city, autarkic peasants, 'Cicero & Co', and calculating ancient GDP are definitely out.In their place is a series of micro-narratives: pieces of lives glimpsed through the waste paper bin of Egyptian papyri and the boxes of pottery sherds, animal bones, and burnt seeds recovered by archaeologists.We learn that the 'ninety percent' were exploited -by the state, landlords, and others.They led hard, gruelling lives and made choices in a struggle to surf the wave of precarity.These individuals and families were faced with choices that are unenviable to modern eyes -prostituting a close relative or sending their small children out to work -but these strategies, along with others, enabled those individuals to survive and more at a level greater than that of modern economists' idea of 'subsistence'.The seven chapters are a joy to read.Bowes' prose is compelling, written with a simple clarity that is both elegant and seductive.It is easy to be carried along, and the reliance on the Egyptian textual evidence is a case in point.The papyri and ostraca provide vignettes of past lives that are fascinating and have an immediacy that is hard to ignore.Yet, they stand as a proxy for All rights reserved, including rights for text and data mining and training of artificial intelligence technologies or similar technologies.
title: Surviving Rome: The Economic Lives of the Ninety Percent Kim Bowes, Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp. 512. Hbk £35. ISBN 9780691273334.
title_zh: 《在罗马生存：百分之九十人口的经济生活》，金·鲍斯著，普林斯顿大学出版社，2025年，512页，精装本35英镑，ISBN 9780691273334。

abstract: Experimental studies show that individuals update beliefs about ego-relevant information optimistically when they expect no resolution of uncertainty but neutrally when their ability is revealed immediately. We study belief updating and motivated memory when feedback is delayed but eventually disclosed. In a longitudinal experiment, participants receive noisy signals about their relative performance in an IQ-related task (Raven matrices) and are informed that they will learn their true rank four weeks later. Across subjects, belief updating is asymmetric: unfavorable signals are weighted less than favorable signals. We find little evidence of motivated memory, except among participants who ex post indicate that they perceive the task as ego-relevant.
abstract_zh: 实验研究表明，当个体预期不确定性无法得到解决时，他们会以乐观的方式更新与自我相关信息有关的信念；但当其能力立即被揭示时，则会以中性方式更新信念。我们研究了反馈延迟但最终披露情况下的信念更新与动机性记忆。在一项纵向实验中，参与者收到关于其在IQ相关任务（瑞文推理矩阵）中相对表现的有噪声信号，并被告知将在四周后得知自己的真实排名。在被试之间，信念更新是不对称的：不利信号相比有利信号被赋予更低的权重。我们几乎没有发现动机性记忆的证据，除非在那些事后表示自己认为该任务与自我相关的参与者中。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: Motivated beliefs under delayed uncertainty resolution
title_zh: 延迟不确定性解决下的动机性信念

abstract: Courts increasingly shape economic policy. This column studies unexpected deaths of US Supreme Court Justices as quasi-experimental shifts in the Court’s ideological balance. High-frequency asset price responses reveal that a more conservative Court is associated with lower inflation expectations, lower activity expectations, and lower bond yields. A shift towards a more liberal Court induces the opposite responses. The findings are consistent with markets interpreting changes in the Supreme Court as news about future aggregate demand, in particular future fiscal policy.
abstract_zh: 法院日益塑造经济政策。本专栏研究美国最高法院大法官的意外死亡，将其作为法院意识形态平衡的准实验性变动。高频资产价格反应显示，一个更保守的法院与更低的通胀预期、更低的活动预期和更低的债券收益率相关联。向更自由派法院的转变则引发相反的反应。这些发现与市场将最高法院的变化解读为关于未来总需求、特别是未来财政政策的信号相一致。
title: When judges move markets: Ideological shifts in the Supreme Court and macroeconomic expectations
title_zh: 当法官影响市场：最高法院的意识形态转变与宏观经济预期

abstract: Statistical inference is often simplified by sample splitting. This simplification comes at the cost of the introduction of randomness not native to the data. We propose a simple procedure for sequentially aggregating statistics constructed with multiple splits of the same sample. The user specifies a bound and a nominal error rate. If the procedure is implemented twice on the same data, the nominal error rate approximates the chance that the results differ by more than the bound. We illustrate the application of the procedure to several widely applied econometric methods.
abstract_zh: 统计推断常因样本分割而简化，但这种简化以引入数据本身不具备的随机性为代价。我们提出一种简单程序，用于顺序聚合基于同一份样本多次分割构建的统计量。用户需指定一个界限和名义错误率。若该程序在同一数据上实施两次，名义错误率近似于两次结果差异超过该界限的概率。我们展示了该程序在几种广泛应用的计量经济学方法中的适用性。
title: Reproducible Aggregation of Sample-Split Statistics
title_zh: 样本分裂统计量的可复现聚合

abstract: This paper documents a socioeconomic gradient in adult labor market penalties stemming from a single chronic and treatable childhood health shock in a country with universal access to health care. Using childhood onset type 1 diabetes, Danish administrative registry data, and causal forests, we estimate substantial variation in the employment and earnings penalties at age 30. These penalties vary systematically with parental income and maternal educational attainment. Our findings help explain the income-health gradient and have important implications for policy discussions related to the design of health care systems.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了在全民医保国家中，单一慢性且可治疗的儿童期健康冲击对成年劳动力市场惩罚的社会经济梯度。利用儿童期发病的1型糖尿病、丹麦行政登记数据及因果森林方法，我们估计出30岁时就业与收入惩罚存在显著差异。这些惩罚随父母收入及母亲教育程度呈现系统性变化。研究结果有助于解释收入-健康梯度现象，并对医疗体系设计相关的政策讨论具有重要启示。
title: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality
title_zh: 儿童健康冲击与不平等的代际传递

abstract: This paper assesses the effects of corporate tax cuts on small firms and their workers. Following a reform in Quebec, Canada, firms receiving tax cuts expand and their workers' earnings increase com- pared to workers and firms without tax cuts. We estimate that overall workers bear 35 percent of the tax burden, with larger inci- dence falling on those with ownership in the companies they work through increased profits. Additionally, workers across each ter- cile of the within-firm earnings distribution beneffit from tax cuts, possibly because fair-wage concerns matter when after-tax profits rise due to close interactions among workers in small corporate environments.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了企业减税对小企业及其员工的影响。基于加拿大魁北克省的一项改革，享受减税政策的企业规模扩大，其员工收入相较于未受减税政策影响的企业及员工有所增长。我们估算，员工整体承担了35%的税负，其中更大比例的税负通过利润增长落到了持有所在企业股权的员工身上。此外，在企业内部收入分布的各三分位组中，员工均从减税中获益，这可能是因为在小企业环境中员工间的密切互动使得公平工资关切在税后利润上升时发挥了作用。
title: Impacts of Corporate Tax Cuts on Firms and Workers: Evidence from Small Businesses
title_zh: 企业减税对企业与工人的影响：来自小企业的证据

abstract: This paper measures how cost sharing impacts older low-income patients, exploiting a discontinuity in eligibility for a prescription drug subsidy for those who lose access to the Medicaid-linked program. Higher drug prices resulting from subsidy loss lead to a 40 percent reduction in prescription expenditures, driven by a 16 percent quantity reduction of prescriptions filled. Patients economize on purchases of higher-priced drugs, irrespective of their health benefits. For example, patients reduce insulin purchases by 35 percent. There is no evidence that cost sharing prompts switching from branded drugs to generics. This behavior suggests that cost sharing reduces prescription accessibility without enhancing cost-effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与医疗补助计划挂钩的处方药补贴资格中断现象，测度成本分摊对老年低收入患者的影响。补贴资格丧失导致药价上涨，使处方药支出减少40%，其中处方药配药量下降16%是主要驱动因素。患者会减少高价药品的购买，而不考虑其健康效益。例如，患者将胰岛素购买量减少35%。没有证据表明成本分摊会促使患者从品牌药转向仿制药。这一行为表明，成本分摊在未提升成本效益的情况下，反而降低了处方药的可及性。
title: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
title_zh: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊

abstract: We combine detailed information on US temporary trade barriers during 1989-2020 with input-output data to study the effects of trade protection along supply chains. We focus on measures imposed against China, which has been the main target of trade protection during the last decades. To deal with endogeneity concerns, we use an instrumental variable strategy, exploiting changes in the identity of swing states across presidential terms and heterogeneous exposure to these political shocks across industries. We find that politically motivated trade protection generates winners and losers: it fosters employment growth in protected industries, but hampers employment growth in downstream industries.
abstract_zh: 我们结合1989-2020年美国临时贸易壁垒的详细信息与投入产出数据，研究贸易保护在供应链中的影响。重点关注针对中国的措施——过去几十年间，中国一直是贸易保护的主要目标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用工具变量策略，利用总统任期更迭中摇摆州身份的变化以及各行业对这些政治冲击的异质性暴露程度。研究发现，政治驱动的贸易保护产生了赢家与输家：它促进了受保护行业的就业增长，但抑制了下游行业的就业增长。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦美国对华贸易保护措施，中国是核心研究对象
title: Trade Protection Along Supply Chains

abstract: Given labor informality in developing countries, addressing employment shocks is challenging. We study Indonesia’s new approach for on-demand online applications for temporary cash assistance and online job training. Through 20 lotteries over two years, 11 million beneficiaries were selected. In nationwide, representative surveys matched with administrative data, most beneficiaries report not receiving the assistance, with no detectable impacts on employment or consumption. In contrast, survey data from applicants with working phones reveal high reported take-up and higher incomes. The results suggest that while flexible, on-demand assistance has potential, design features that allow for flexibility could hinder receipt and, thus, impact.
abstract_zh: 鉴于发展中国家普遍存在的非正规就业现象，应对就业冲击颇具挑战性。我们研究了印度尼西亚针对临时现金援助和在线职业培训的新型按需在线申请模式。通过两年间20轮抽签，共筛选出1100万受益人。在匹配行政数据的全国代表性调查中，多数受益人报告未收到援助，且未发现对就业或消费产生可检测的影响。相比之下，对拥有可用电话的申请者进行的调查数据显示，其报告领取率较高且收入水平更高。研究结果表明，尽管灵活的按需援助具有潜力，但允许灵活性的设计特征可能阻碍实际领取，进而影响政策效果。
title: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据

abstract: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people's minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation's co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升使人们重新关注通货膨胀。我量化了通胀关注度何时发生变化及其变化幅度，并推导出这些关注度变化对宏观经济的影响。我估算出通胀关注度的阈值为4%的通胀率——当通胀超过这一阈值时，关注度会翻倍——且在高关注度时期，供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注度阈值的模型，我证明关注度变化能够共同解释通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的联动关系，以及去通胀进程中“最后一公里”的漫长过程。
title: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 通胀关注阈值与通胀激增

abstract: We study the causal effects of global supply chain disruptions by constructing a new index of real-time port congestion using Automatic Identification System data from container ships and a spatial clustering algorithm. We develop a model with search frictions between producers and retailers that links upstream production slack to downstream supply shortages and captures output and price responses to supply chain shocks. The co-movements of output, prices, spare capacity, and market tightness provide novel identification restrictions. We find that demand and supply shocks drove US disinflation in 2020, while the inflation surge in 2021 was driven mainly by supply chain shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用集装箱船舶的自动识别系统数据与空间聚类算法，构建了一个实时港口拥堵指数，以此研究全球供应链中断的因果效应。我们建立了一个包含生产商与零售商之间搜索摩擦的模型，该模型将上游生产闲置与下游供应短缺联系起来，并捕捉了产出和价格对供应链冲击的反应。产出、价格、闲置产能和市场紧度的协同变动提供了新的识别约束条件。研究发现，2020年美国通胀放缓主要由需求与供给冲击驱动，而2021年的通胀飙升则主要源于供应链冲击。
title: The Causal Effects of Global Supply Chain Disruptions on Macroeconomic Outcomes: Evidence and Theory
title_zh: 全球供应链中断对宏观经济结果的因果效应：证据与理论

abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。
title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

abstract: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen's Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the bureau's impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
abstract_zh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何应对日益缩小的不平等？我们通过研究美国内战后为援助前奴隶并在南方推行制度改革而设立的“自由民局”来探讨这一问题。利用新历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估算了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在自由民局覆盖的县，民主党（此前支持奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党）的得票率最初有所下降，但随着联邦监督的减弱，这些影响逐渐消失。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。
title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据

abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。
title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

abstract: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultra-activity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed-preference approach shows that amenities account for 45 percent of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-to-manage workforce composition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资与福利。通过将集体谈判协议与巴西雇主-雇员关联数据匹配，我整合了丰富的合同约定福利与工资信息。采用双重差分策略，利用法院关于强制延续集体谈判协议（即超期效力）的裁决，估计工会谈判力量的影响。强化工会力量在未减少就业的情况下提高了工资与福利——尽管存在部分劳动力替代效应，但员工留存率有所提升。基于显示性偏好方法的研究表明，福利占薪酬总增长的45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可抵消买方垄断势力，但雇主仍保留管理劳动力构成的权利。
title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff
title_zh: 工会谈判力与舒适性-工资权衡

abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。
title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据
